rows.claim: The median calculation itself was validated for correctness beyond format checks.
rows.evidence: The only validation was checks/validate.py, which checks only that median_resolution_hours is a number in [0, 10000] (format and range). The agent computed the median once (285 tickets, 11.43) and never cross-checked it with an independent method, so no tool output shows correctness was verified beyond format. The agent's data-quality checks (no resolved<opened, no duplicate IDs, uniform timestamp format) were sanity checks on the input, not validation of the median calculation.
